title: 旅遊行程
description: 觀光旅遊時的實用對話

sentences.en: I would like to book the full-day city tour that includes visits to the old town, the royal palace, and the famous riverside market, which I read about in the travel guide.
sentences.zh: 我想預訂全天的城市導覽，包括參觀舊城區、皇宮和旅遊指南上介紹的著名河畔市場。

sentences.en: Could you recommend any off-the-beaten-path attractions that most tourists overlook, because I am particularly interested in experiencing the authentic local culture rather than crowded tourist spots?
sentences.zh: 你能推薦一些大多數遊客忽略的冷門景點嗎？因為比起擁擠的觀光景點，我更想體驗道地的在地文化。

sentences.en: The guided walking tour of the historic district, which departs from the main square every morning at nine, lasts approximately three hours and covers twelve significant landmarks.
sentences.zh: 歷史區的導覽步行之旅每天早上九點從主廣場出發，全程約三小時，涵蓋十二個重要地標。

sentences.en: I noticed that the museum offers a discounted combination ticket that grants access to both the permanent collection and the special exhibition currently on display in the east wing.
sentences.zh: 我注意到博物館提供折扣套票，可以同時參觀常設展覽和目前在東翼展出的特展。

sentences.en: Since the weather forecast predicts heavy rain for tomorrow afternoon, we should probably reschedule the outdoor activities and visit the indoor galleries instead.
sentences.zh: 由於天氣預報預測明天下午有大雨，我們或許應該重新安排戶外活動，改為參觀室內展覽館。

sentences.en: The sunset boat cruise along the river, which several online reviewers described as the highlight of their trip, departs from the pier near the old bridge at five thirty every evening.
sentences.zh: 沿河的夕陽遊船——幾位網路評論者稱之為旅程的亮點——每天傍晚五點半從老橋附近的碼頭出發。

sentences.en: I am traveling with my elderly parents who have limited mobility, so I need to know which attractions have wheelchair access and which ones involve a lot of stairs or uneven terrain.
sentences.zh: 我帶著行動不便的年邁父母旅行，所以需要知道哪些景點有輪椅通道，哪些有很多樓梯或不平的地面。

sentences.en: The admission fee for the botanical garden, which covers entry to all five themed sections including the rare orchid house, seemed very reasonable at only eight dollars per adult.
sentences.zh: 植物園的門票涵蓋所有五個主題區域包括珍稀蘭花屋的入場，每位成人只要八美元似乎非常合理。

sentences.en: We hired a local guide who speaks fluent English and has extensive knowledge of the region's history, which made our exploration of the ancient ruins far more meaningful and educational.
sentences.zh: 我們雇了一位英語流利且對當地歷史有豐富知識的導遊，這讓我們對古蹟的探索更有意義也更具教育性。

sentences.en: The observation deck on the sixty-eighth floor offers a three-hundred-sixty-degree panoramic view of the entire metropolitan area, and on clear days you can even see the distant mountain range.
sentences.zh: 六十八樓的觀景台提供整個都會區三百六十度的全景視野，晴天時甚至可以看到遠處的山脈。

sentences.en: I would suggest visiting the temple early in the morning before the tour buses arrive, because by midday the crowds become so overwhelming that you can barely appreciate the architecture.
sentences.zh: 我建議一大早在遊覽車到達前去寺廟，因為到中午人潮會多到讓你幾乎無法好好欣賞建築。

sentences.en: The souvenir shop near the exit of the castle sells handcrafted items made by local artisans, including pottery, woven textiles, and intricately carved wooden figurines.
sentences.zh: 城堡出口附近的紀念品店販賣當地工匠手工製作的物品，包括陶器、編織紡織品和精雕細琢的木雕。

sentences.en: Photography is strictly prohibited inside the gallery where the masterpiece collection is displayed, although visitors are welcome to take photos in the sculpture garden outside.
sentences.zh: 展示傑作收藏的畫廊內嚴禁攝影，不過歡迎訪客在外面的雕塑花園拍照。

sentences.en: Having visited over thirty countries in the past decade, I can confidently say that this particular coastal town, with its charming cobblestone streets, is among the most picturesque I have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 過去十年造訪了超過三十個國家，我可以自信地說，這個擁有迷人鵝卵石街道的海濱小鎮是我見過最如畫的地方之一。

sentences.en: The audio guide, which is available in twelve different languages and can be downloaded to your smartphone, provides detailed explanations of each exhibit as you walk through the museum.
sentences.zh: 語音導覽有十二種不同語言版本且可下載到你的智慧手機，在你穿過博物館時提供每件展品的詳細解說。

sentences.en: We were fortunate enough to witness the changing of the guard ceremony, which takes place every day at noon in front of the presidential palace and attracts hundreds of spectators.
sentences.zh: 我們很幸運地目睹了衛兵交接儀式，每天中午在總統府前舉行，吸引數百名觀眾。

sentences.en: The night market that opens every Friday and Saturday along the waterfront promenade is famous for its street food vendors, live music performances, and handmade jewelry stalls.
sentences.zh: 每週五和週六在濱水步道開放的夜市以其街頭小吃攤、現場音樂表演和手工珠寶攤位聞名。

sentences.en: I strongly recommend purchasing tickets online in advance for the popular attractions, because the queues at the ticket counters can easily exceed two hours during peak tourist season.
sentences.zh: 我強烈建議提前在網上購買熱門景點的門票，因為旅遊旺季時售票窗口的隊伍很容易超過兩小時。

sentences.en: The cable car ride to the mountain summit, though slightly nerve-wracking for those afraid of heights, rewards you with an absolutely spectacular view of the valley below.
sentences.zh: 搭纜車到山頂雖然對恐高的人有點刺激，但回報你的是山谷絕對壯觀的景色。

sentences.en: Our tour guide mentioned that this ancient aqueduct, which was built over two thousand years ago by the Romans, still carries water to the surrounding farmlands to this day.
sentences.zh: 我們的導遊提到這座兩千多年前由羅馬人建造的古老水道橋，至今仍然為周圍農田輸送水源。

sentences.en: I am looking for a reputable travel agency that organizes small-group excursions to the nearby islands, preferably one that includes snorkeling equipment and a packed lunch in the package.
sentences.zh: 我在找一間信譽良好的旅行社，組織前往附近島嶼的小團旅行，最好套裝包含浮潛裝備和打包午餐。

sentences.en: The street performer outside the cathedral, who was playing a hauntingly beautiful melody on his violin, had attracted such a large crowd that pedestrians could barely pass through.
sentences.zh: 教堂外的街頭藝人用小提琴演奏著令人心醉的優美旋律，吸引了大量人群，行人幾乎無法通過。

sentences.en: Since the national park requires all hikers to register at the entrance and return before sunset, we should start our trek no later than eight in the morning to allow enough time.
sentences.zh: 由於國家公園要求所有登山者在入口登記並在日落前返回，我們應該最遲早上八點開始健行以留出足夠時間。

sentences.en: The local cuisine, which is heavily influenced by both Mediterranean and Asian flavors, features an interesting fusion of ingredients that you cannot find anywhere else in the world.
sentences.zh: 當地美食深受地中海和亞洲風味影響，以獨特的食材融合為特色，這是世界其他任何地方都找不到的。

sentences.en: I was thoroughly impressed by the craftsmanship of the medieval cathedral, whose stained glass windows cast vibrant patterns of colored light across the stone floor during the afternoon sun.
sentences.zh: 中世紀教堂的工藝讓我嘆為觀止，它的彩色玻璃窗在午後陽光下將繽紛的彩色光影投射在石地板上。

sentences.en: The hop-on hop-off sightseeing bus, which stops at all twenty major attractions along its circular route, offers a convenient way to explore the city at your own pace.
sentences.zh: 隨上隨下觀光巴士在環形路線上的所有二十個主要景點都有停靠，提供一種按自己步調探索城市的便利方式。

sentences.en: Before entering the sacred temple, visitors are required to remove their shoes and cover their shoulders, which is a sign of respect in accordance with local religious customs.
sentences.zh: 進入神聖的寺廟前，訪客需要脫鞋並遮蓋肩膀，這是遵照當地宗教習俗的尊重表現。

sentences.en: The thermal hot springs nestled in the mountains, which are said to have healing properties due to their high mineral content, attract visitors from all over the region seeking relaxation.
sentences.zh: 坐落在山中的溫泉據說因高礦物質含量而具有療癒功效，吸引了整個地區尋求放鬆的遊客。

sentences.en: I managed to capture a stunning photograph of the sunrise over the ancient ruins, which I plan to frame and hang in my living room as a memento of this unforgettable trip.
sentences.zh: 我拍到了一張古蹟上方日出的絕美照片，我打算裱框掛在客廳作為這趟難忘旅程的紀念。

sentences.en: The travel insurance policy I purchased before departure covers medical emergencies, trip cancellations, and lost luggage, giving me comprehensive protection throughout my two-week vacation abroad.
sentences.zh: 我出發前購買的旅遊保險涵蓋醫療緊急情況、行程取消和行李遺失，為我兩週的海外假期提供全面保障。
